reviews.text: My contractor Greg with Landscape investment was able to transform my unusable yard into a yard that will bring value and usability back to my residence. What stands out most is fair pricing, quality materials, and work crews that show up when scheduled. Greg also was on site each day to ensure the project was  being carried out as designed. I was never rushed into the project and Greg was very accommodating to offer recommendations and work through my unique request, giving ample time to consider my project design. My before and after photos best show the improvement to the yard
reviews.author: Joseph Courville

reviews.text: Working with Landscape Investments, LLC was a breeze, and they handled everything seamlessly. They did an excellent job installing a chain-link fence around the back perimeter and a wooden fence at the front. The entire experience was smooth from start to finish. Greg Davis and his team were fantastic to work with, and the crew showed great attention to detail throughout the project. Greg was very professional. Highly recommended!
reviews.author: Shahedul Islam

reviews.text: I chose Landscape Investment LLC because of their competitive estimate on a board-on-board cedar fence. Impressed with the companies A+ rating with BBB. The crew were on time, each man knew his responsibility, the fence came together in short order. I’m very pleased with the look of the fence and the 5 year guarantee. I would use Landscape Investment again.
reviews.author: Jeffrey Janes

reviews.text: Gregg was wonderful, very easy to work with and the fence is beautiful! I got estimates from 5 companies and Landscape Investment came in the lowest, but that is not the only reason I hired them. It was one of the few companies that the owner came out to give me an estimate and let me know he would be by the site everyday it was being worked on to check on things. Which is exactly what happened. Gregg is honest and likable and his crew does beautiful work. I highly recommend!
reviews.author: Tammy List

reviews.text: Update 9/28/2025:  Unfortunately I have to amend my previous glowing review of 5 stars to 3 stars. I thought the fence was well done, but some slats slipped and I discovered there were zero nails keeping it together. This was less than two months of completion. I sent photos to Greg Davis and he gave me various explanations but never offered to rectify the situation. Instead he informed me he was going on vacation for three weeks. That was before Labor Day. After countless text inquiries of me asking when my fence would be fixed and completed and after countless text excuses and promises from Greg, I have given up.  The fence is beautiful, but not complete. He got my money and that’s it, I guess. There were issues with the other work that was done on my property (more excuses), but I’m DONE.
reviews.author: Mari Warnick

reviews.text: Landscape Investments did a great job installing our new fence!! They did all this in 1 day!, There fence looks great! I highly recommend using this company!, They are very professional and thorough!
reviews.author: Paul Boatman

reviews.text:
Greg installed our new fence 4 years ago and it was the hit of the neighborhood. We had several people stop to ask questions and we were able to share the good news.
Earlier this year we experienced a hail storm that damaged our fence cosmetically. The fence remained strong and required no alterations. Our insurance covered a cleaning and re-staining and of course we called Greg to take care of this for us.
And as always he was prompt, reasonable and provided top of the line quality and service. We never fail to recommend him whenever possible.
Thanks for all your help Greg.
reviews.author: Richard Linn

reviews.text: Greg has done several jobs for me and they're always done efficiently and for a very competitive price. This last one involved moving a fence and building new panels to fill in the gaps. The work took less than a day, even considering some situations that came up, which they handled patiently and professionally.
reviews.author: Stephen Wylie

reviews.text:
I would not recommend Greg/Landscape Investments for decking.  We spent approximately $15k and it took 1 month for a Trek deck that looks like an amateur built it. While he had his subcontracted crew come back a few times, the end result is a deck that I will rip out as soon as I am able and use a professional company.  I wanted to give the local guy the business, while I had other quotes from commercial companies at the same price.  I won't make that mistake again.

Update: As noted, Greg agreed it was a botched job.  I texted him after this review 2 weeks ago.  He said he would speak with his foreman and get back to me.  2 weeks later and no response and backyard that I have not been able to use for almost 2 months, I am beyond frustrated.  It appears as if his response was strictly for the benefit of the google reviewers. I now would give 0 stars if I could.
reviews.author: Andrea Taylor

reviews.text: Greg and his crew did great work! They got our fence up in two days and it looks beautiful! There were a couple of small issues but the guys came back to fix them the next day. Will definitely use them again to build out the other half of our fence when we're ready.
reviews.author: Jacqueline Rodriguez

reviews.text: Very happy with our new fence. From quote to build took less than a week, even during the holidays. Would recommend a Greg and his crew for any fence projects.
reviews.author: Isaac Johnson

reviews.text: Did my homework and landed with Greg at Landscape Investments. He had a quick response with competitive pricing and made a few suggestions that we did not think of in making the aesthetics better. The crew was available in less than a week and did a quality job in an efficient timeframe. I love how it turned out - better than I imagined. Will definitely refer all my friends and family.
reviews.author: Keeva Sucher

reviews.text: Greg sent Junior out a few years ago to help us with our yard. Junior removed an iron fence before installing a 6 foot fence with a lattice top for us. I called around and not many companies were willing to do the semi privacy lattice top. It has been holding up well and it gave us the privacy that we wanted.
reviews.author: Rich Lo

reviews.text:
From the quote to the finishing touches Greg provided professional and friendly
Service with a high quality product.  The fence he replaced was constructed beautifully and the fences that only needed to be stained came out better than we expected.  He is very responsive and his crew was highly professional.  He will be out ‘Fence Guy’ forever!
reviews.author: Harolyn Watts

reviews.text:
UPDATE 5/2024

A tree branch fell and damaged my fence during the storm last week; I contacted Greg (owner) via phone. He was out of town but still insisted on getting photos and providing me with 3 options and estimates. It was not an urgent need (fence was still keeping dogs in) so he was able to dispatch a crew the following week. They were punctual and from arrival to departure completed the repair in 45 minutes. Pricing was, as before, fair and upfront.

***

Couldn't recommend more highly! Short read: great price, quality work, excellent communication, done on time.
Listen, have you ever wanted to level up your fence game, but thought "no, it's too expensive" or "I just can't devote the time and loss of use of the backyard for such a big project"? I certainly did, on both counts. Enter Landscape Investments, LLC. I'll get to the meat of it: I placed a call for an estimate one afternoon. 3.5 business days later, I had a fence. Start to finish, Greg (the owner, who personally gave the estimate and checked in during build time) and his crew were the very model of professionalism. Price? They have you covered. I was so surprised at the reasonable estimate I had to badger Greg into upselling me on extras, just so I could see what options were out there. The fence? Gorgeous. Plus, they did the fencing at my girlfriend's house 5 years ago and it still looks absolutely brand new, so you know they'll do it right. Speed? Like I said, from first call to completion, Greg and his top-notch pro crew had me a 6-foot board on board done in under 4 days. Support local businesses. Put your money back in the local economy. Get a fence from these folks. It's truly the most patriotic thing you could do.
reviews.author: Ian Moore

reviews.text:
We hired landscape investments to rip out our old 6 ft fence and automatic gate and replace with a new 8ft fence. Greg was a joy to deal with and extremely transparent about the work and the pricing.

All the work was done in a timely manner and according to the schedule given to us. The fence looks great and we are extremely happy with the work. Looking forward to our next project with Greg and the team!
reviews.author: Chad

reviews.text: Richard was amazing! He charges very reasonably and is skilled at the job. He did a good job repairing my broken fence. He is an excellent example of good customer service.
reviews.author: Just Another

reviews.text: Greg Davis of Landscape Investments did a fence and gate repair for me. He promptly came out to assess the job and gave me a fair pricing for the work needed. Mr. Davis and crew arrived on time and did an excellent job with the repairs. I am so pleased!!!!
reviews.author: Pam Buggs

reviews.text:
Greg and his team did an excellent job on our new fence. From start to finish, Greg was professional, attentive, and efficient. He provided great recommendations that fit our needs perfectly. The quality of the materials and workmanship was outstanding. The project was completed on time, and our yard was left clean and tidy. We highly recommend Greg and his fence company for any fencing needs. Thank you, Greg!

Tamar Prather
reviews.author: Tamar Prather

reviews.text: Greg is great to work with. His team is Fast and has quality in mind. The neighbors shared wonderful comments of the appearance and quick turn around.
reviews.author: R Ng

reviews.text: We have used the services of Greg Davis, Landscape Investments, for 6+ years on several fencing projects:  both residential and commercial. We have found him to be very professional; excellent work and work ethics; I believe competitive pricing; timely; a great advisor; and is personable.  He itemizes everything, and does his best to meet your time schedule and your needs.  On the project just completed, there was a very short timespan (about 3 weeks) before the building permit would expire, due to our complicated situation. This project entailed building two 75’x 6’ brick walls, AND his crew completed it on time which is very commendable for such a large job. The cleanup was great and fast.  Thank you Greg Davis!  We appreciate you and your crew and definitely feel a recommendation is in order.
reviews.author: Shirley W

reviews.text: Since moving to Corinth, I have utilized Landscape Investments both directly and through referrals. Greg operates his company with complete integrity, and the quality of his crew's work has always been impeccable. I highly recommend him. Given the high costs of everything, it’s essential that your spending yields maximum impact.
reviews.author: Erhard Scharfe

reviews.text: I was very happy with the fence work done by Landscape Investments. Greg (the owner) quickly came out and gave me a competitive bid for the job. He was also very flexible with some changes I added to the job and kept me well informed as the work progressed. I would definitely use Landscape Investments again and highly recommend Greg for your fencing needs

reviews.text: Greg is easy to work with and gives great advice to help with your vision of what you need.  His crew is quick, efficient and builds a great product.

reviews.text: Excellent communication and execution exceeded commitment.  I could not be happier with the outcome and will stand up for them anytime.  Straight talk and no waste of time.... You will get better than promised delivery!!!!

reviews.text: Greg was very friendly and knowledgeable when he came to evaluate my home project. He listened to what I wanted and provided best options for the type of work we discussed. The day of the fence installation, he was onsite with his team and completed the project the same day. I am very pleased and highly recommend.

reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience!  Greg is very informative and efficient. Our new fence was completed quickly and just like we wanted for a very reasonable cost.

reviews.text: I contacted Greg 2 years ago to replace our fence but the project didn't pushed through. Last month, I called him again as we already decided to replace our fence. His crew did great in the installation. His pricing is unmatched as well. I will definitely recommend him to my friends who are looking for a quality fence installation.

reviews.text: After receiving quotes from four local fence companies i decided to go with Landscape Investments and so pleased that I did. Not only were they the lowest price, but the installed results are top quality, I couldn't be happier.  Greg provides excellent personal service and was on-site every day his crews were here. You won't get that with other cookie-cutter contractors. My fence project had some challenging circumstances but Greg worked with me and made suggestions on reducing the cost. The project started on time, finished early and looks great. I highly recommend Landscape Investments and would use them again without hesitation.
reviews.author: Scott Imbery

reviews.text: We are so pleased with our new fence! Greg was easy to work with and they got the old fence torn down and new fence up in 2.5 days start to finish. The crew was efficient and did a fabulous job and the finished product is sturdy, well-built and beautiful. Cannot recommend Landscape Investments highly enough!
reviews.author: Erin Martin

reviews.text: Greg and his crew recently replaced the old wore-out fence around our yard with a brand-new wood fence. The whole process from bidding through scheduling, building, and clean-up was smooth and stress-free. The price was very reasonable and the finished product was beautiful. We are very satisfied with the job they did. They were prompt, courteous, professional, and responsive. We highly recommend Landscape Investments for your next project.
reviews.author: Jerry Whitworth

reviews.text: I had a large fence project, and received multiple quotes with Landscape Investments being the lowest bidder and they lived up to their very high rating.  They removed an old chainlink fence and built a Douglas Fir fence enclosing the entirety of my backyard on almost a half acre lot.  The owner, Greg, consulted with me the entire time to make sure it was exactly what I wanted, my fence is well stained and I’m confident it will last a long time.  I could tell the crew had worked together before and was experienced at building fences. I felt like my business was a high priority and they were able to complete the entire project in two days despite its size.  They’re a small local business, and Greg is a personable family man and was onsite throughout the process to ensure the fence was built to a high standard.
reviews.author: Kael Berger

reviews.text: Landscape Investments gave us A++ quality and service on our new fence design and installation. Greg was very knowledgeable, promptly returned all of my calls, and made the entire process seamless. Providing excellent quality at a fair price was a promise kept. His team was also very professional and efficient. Our new fence is absolutely beautiful, and I look forward to working with Landscape Investments on future home beautification projects!
reviews.author: Allison Pentecost

reviews.text: Greg was great to work with. They did a great job and were so helpful and responsive through the process. We did an 8 ft board on board with a cap. Greg worked to give us the best price and they had our fence up in no time. Then, he also helped us redo our landscaping and we could not be happier. 10/10 would recommend and will be using him for anything we need in the future.
reviews.author: Jansen Patterson

reviews.text: Great work and value package! Our fence is way too old and overdue, Greg and his team make it brand new in two days. Greg is a very respectful and responsive business man. Recommended without any concerns.
reviews.author: Jane Ji

reviews.text: Greg was great to work with. I took bids from several companies, but chose Landscape Investments because of Greg's engagement from the beginning. He is responsive and communicates through the whole process. Greg was open to my request for additional work, after the project started and didn't miss a beat in assisting me. I had my existing deck/fence restained and had a portion of new metal post fence built. I couldn't be happier!
reviews.author: Ginger Leigh

reviews.text:
I definitely recommend Greg and Landscape  Investments. Our project involved an enormous shared privacy fence and 4-5 neighbors all having to agree and coordinate....which took us (neighbors) nearly 3-4 months to figure out. Greg was patient and helpful, and made multiple trips out. His pricing was the best we found, and the quality of work was excellent. His crew was very quick, and we are very happy with the overall experience. Oh and also, we wrote a couple checks to him that bounced (our fault, transferred to the wrong account)...and Greg was very patient and reassuring. He even responded to a late night panic text I sent about not cashing a big check I wrote, and the next morning he sent a picture of the ripped up check. A trustworthy contractor, and someone I would do business with again. (Of course, we got him all paid up, lol).

Do yourself a favor and add this company to your list for a quote!
reviews.author: Sky McClure

reviews.text:
Greg and his team did an amazing job replacing our old fence. The new fence is well built and made out of much better quality materias.

He did a great job explaining the process, costs and  accommodating  some additional requests.
reviews.author: IJ Rivera

reviews.text: Greg with Landscape Investments was great to work with. Great communication, beat competitors pricing, and very prompt install. We love our new fence and have already received several compliments from our neighbors. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Shannon M

reviews.text: Right before they installed my fence they lost their main guy because he moved back to Mexico. They sent a crew that could not speak English and made a ton of mistakes.  They also left them unsupervised! I missed a bunch of work going out there stopping them from doing stupid stuff. They had to come out and fix a number of things several times and insisted that I pay their people even though they're the ones that made the mistake. Now I see that they did not put enough concrete around the poles... Less than 2 in deep. I'm about to lose my entire fence on one side due to the wind. Because of this. I could go on and on about every little thing that went wrong when it came to working with them. The owner cuts corners and is cheap.  I paid over $9,000 for a fence that's about to be blown over now... Yes just past the warranty too. They wouldn't come out and fix it before the warranty because they said that I wasn't watering my poles. You should not have to water your fence poles for them to stay. The concrete has to be deep enough to hold and it just is not. It's only 2 in. Not only that, it was supposed to be a 6-ft fence and in several places it's only 5 ft.  This was a long-term investment that I'm definitely not happy with. Don't let the Christian fish on his business card fool you.  They also messed up one of the gates and now I have to look at a crooked gate forever. It also has a huge gap at the bottom... Good thing I don't have a little dog, but I can't get one either until this gate gets fixed and that would take doing it over from scratch which is why he never fixed it.
reviews.author: Riki Young

reviews.text: Highly recommend. Very friendly and competitive pricing. Quick installation with exceptional quality. Will use again for future fencing needs
reviews.author: Gerald Brown

reviews.text: When you live 1400 miles away from your project, you need to find a reputable vendor. I received 3 recommendations for Greg's service and I hired him to do a project in a short amount of time. His company delivered results on time. When I called and asked for a few gate changes, his crew was out there the very next dsy.

reviews.text: Had Greg and his crew put up a 6 ft. Board on board fence. The job was done to perfection. His crew was extremely professional and left the job completely clean of any material. I would recommend landscape Investments to all my friends

reviews.text: Outstanding work. Board on Board Fence looks really great.  They even repaired one side of fence that was in poor state. Their fence quality of the wood/stain is above and beyond.

reviews.text: Mr. Davis was very professional, knowledgeable, and ascertained exactly what we were looking for to enhance our landscape with new fencing. His crew did an outstanding job!! The quality and value were exceptional!! I highly recommend Landscape Investments for all fence needs!
reviews.author: Laura Collins

reviews.text: I call Greg for all my big landscaping needs. He put in a 8’ board on board fence and stained it. He has also put in Zoysia grass and it is absolutely the best my lawn has ever looked!! He has redone my flower beds on occasion especially for special occasions! Great job, great workers!! I will always call these guys for my next project!!
reviews.author: Debbie Poston

reviews.text: I would definitely recommend Greg and his crew. Greg was prompt, professional, and patient. He listened to me and delivered exactly what I asked for and what he promised. Happy to support a local company!
reviews.author: Kerry Mitchell

reviews.text: These guys are the best! We contacted them months ago for an estimate; skip ahead almost a year later and  recent wind storm knocked our old fence down and when we called the owner, not only remembered who we were but also kept the same quote he gave us. They came out within the week and set up our new fence in 2 days. They were extremely knowledgeable about the materials and worked with the budget we had! Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Nick Ziegler

reviews.text: Gregg was great to work with as I share a fence with 2 neighbors so he was able to make us all happy. It was installed quickly and looks great.  I will definitely use Landscape Investments in the future and recommend them to my neighbors.
reviews.author: helen richardson

reviews.text: This company was actually recommended to me by a friend but based on my experience I would not recommend them. The fence turned out okay (hence the 3 stars) but the service less than par.  No notice of when they would be out other than an “we are on the way” text the day they were coming and at the same time changing scope of requirements necessary to do the work sent the day of that initial text making it more expensive for me. I would have changed contractors if I had not already received a check for 1/2 from my neighbor made payable to Landscape Investments.  Learned my lesson on that one.  I also had multiple issues with the crew not cleaning up after themselves had to call the owner twice to come back and clean up
reviews.author: Lynette Cleveland

reviews.text: Had to replace 85' of collapsing fence and gate. Greg promptly came out, inspected scope of the job, and provided a quote on the spot. Quote was thorough and detailed, easy to understand, and on par with or lower in cost than quotes from other companies. Quality of work was top-notch, and job was started and completed ahead of schedule. New fence is beautiful and we're getting many envious compliments from neighbors. Couldn't be happier!
reviews.author: James Strawn

reviews.text: Phenomenal experience. Quick, professional, experienced, and a great value! We love our new fence and are so excited to enjoy our backyard again! Highly recommend Landscape Investments - it’s truly a worthwhile investment in your home!

reviews.text: Greg and the team at Landscape Investments were fantastic. Don't let their reasonable prices fool you, their work and customer service is top-notch. Don't waste your time like I did, call Landscape Investments first!

reviews.text: This is the second time I’ve used Greg and his team each time with a group of neighbors. Always great work.

reviews.text: Greg saved the day!  He came out on a cold blustery Saturday to do an emergency fence repair.  Then he came back the following week and completed the repair, not only on my fence but the backdoor neighbors fence which caused the damage to my fence!  It was a two-fer.  Thanks Greg!

reviews.text: Had a new shared fence installed with my neighbor, and had my existing fence re-stained.  Top notch work, and very competitive pricing.  Would recommend to everyone needing fence work.  Very, very pleased with the quality of work and customer service.

data.summary: Reviews appear overwhelmingly authentic. The business has a 40-year history and A+ BBB rating. Positive reviews are detailed and varied. Negative reviews focus on specific, credible issues (deck quality, communication, post-installation fixes) and do not allege fraud or non-payment, suggesting a generally reputable contractor with occasional service/quality hiccups, particularly on non-core fence projects.
fake_signals: No clear fake signals detected in sample. High volume of 5-star reviews is plausible for a 40-year business.
authentic_signals: Specific details: project types (fence, deck, yard transformation), crew names (Greg), timelines, 5-year guarantee
Mix of praise and specific constructive criticism
Negative reviews contain specific, credible details (project cost $15k, crew language barrier, slat/nail issue)
Long-term customer returning for service (4-year review)
data.discrepancy_explanation: No significant discrepancies. High Google rating aligns with BBB A+ accreditation and long business history. Lack of Yelp rating data is not a red flag.
